title: Reception: Buzi Families Calling, Line 2 Holding

fields.orgName: Harbourlight Relief International — Beira Country Office

transcript.speaker: Fátima Langa
transcript.text: Senhor, sorry, it's Fátima at reception. I have had three calls in ten minutes. All three are about the Buzi team.

transcript.speaker: Fátima Langa
transcript.text: The first was the wife of Abílio, the driver. She heard on the radio news that near Guara-Guara the water reached the roofs of the houses. She is crying, she wants to know if he is alive.

transcript.speaker: Fátima Langa
transcript.text: The second was the mother of Graça, the mobiliser. She says Graça always sends a message at night and last night, nothing. She asked if we have spoken to her.

transcript.speaker: Fátima Langa
transcript.text: The third is the brother of Celso, the WASH officer. He says he will drive to Buzi himself this morning. He has a pickup. He wants to know which road our car took so he can follow it.

transcript.speaker: Fátima Langa
transcript.text: I told them all to wait, that the director will call. But I do not know what I am allowed to say. Can I tell the brother the road? Can I say they are safe?

transcript.speaker: Fátima Langa
transcript.text: The brother is still holding on line 2, senhor. What do I tell him, and what do I say when the others call back?

voiceStyles.Fátima Langa: Mozambican woman in her 30s, Portuguese-accented English, speaking quickly and quietly, anxious but trying to stay professional; generator hum and a second phone line ringing behind her

instructorNote: This tests duty of care and the HMSSSP 3 and 6 steps while the facts are still unconfirmed. Watch for: the SFP logging the out-of-contact report within the hour; the CD and SFP stopping Buzi movements and sending an alert that says 'three HRI staff' with no names or route; one named family focal point; only cleared facts given ('no contact since 19:40, search under way, call back by 09:00'); and the brother asked not to travel, with the road never given.

citations.quote: HRI uses four threat levels: 1 (low), 2 (moderate), 3 (high, serious threat), 4 (critical). The Country Director sets the level for each area on the advice of the Security Focal Point after the SRA. F
